title: The ordered-pair Cauchy bound for the general-ratio geometric series
statement: CReal.geomCauchyOfLtOrdered is the a<=b-ordered leaf lemma geomCauchyOfLt's case split consumes: it bounds the partial-sum gap between indices a<=b of sumRange (x^n) via the reciprocal-of-(1-x) bound witness -- the general-ratio analogue of geomCauchyOrderedHalf (the fixed-ratio-1/2 leaf).
